question: The two square roots of a positive number are \(2a-1\) and \(-a+4\). Find this positive number.
solution: The two square roots of a positive number are opposites, so \((2a-1)+(-a+4)=0\), giving \(a=-3\). The two square roots are \(-7\) and \(7\), so the positive number is \(49\).
